metas.name: 1 · ★ 8.1 · 1975 · Jaws
metas.description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.8 · 1978 · Jaws 2
metas.description: Police chief Brody must protect the citizens of Amity after a second monstrous shark begins terrorizing the waters.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.8 · 1983 · Jaws 3-D
metas.description: A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.1 · 1987 · Jaws: The Revenge
metas.description: Chief Brody's widow believes that her family is deliberately being targeted by another shark in search of revenge.
